name: Living Cautery
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 3.2-block radius for 11 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 1 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Heals 2.25 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 8.8 s
• Growth: up to 4 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
